label: Injured
description: -1 to every stat until the injury is treated. A night's rest or a visit to the infirmary clears it.

label: Exhausted
description: -2 to Practice until you rest. Cramming, a long chase, or too many spells can cause it.

label: Frazzled
description: -2 to Theory until the scene ends or someone talks you down. A hard exam, a paradox, or a bad research roll can cause it.

label: Embarrassed
description: -2 to Charm until the scene ends or a friend supports you. Public failure, a prank gone wrong, or a dressing-down can cause it.

label: Marked
description: -2 to Cunning while a teacher, prefect, or rival is watching you. It ends when the heat dies down or you clear your name.

label: Burnout
description: -1 to every stat until you take real downtime and address it. The GM names the shape it takes: Probation, Arcana Fatigue, or Suspicion.

label: Probation
description: -2 to Charm with faculty while you are on probation. It ends when the terms are met or the year turns.

label: Arcana Fatigue
description: -2 to Practice until you spend real time away from magic. It ends with rest and a quiet day.

label: Suspicion
description: -2 to Cunning while the faculty are watching you. It ends when the suspicion is answered or the year turns.
